items.front: Who founded the Shunga dynasty and how (185 BCE)?
items.back: Pushyamitra Shunga, by assassinating the last Maurya Brihadratha.

items.front: Which sacrifices did Pushyamitra perform?

items.front: Grammarian at Pushyamitra's court and his work?

items.front: Kalidasa's play about the Shunga founder's son?

items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Shunga-period stupa railings discovered by Cunningham?

items.front: Who founded the Kanva dynasty and when (73 BCE)?
items.back: Vasudeva Kanva (a Brahmin minister) by killing last Shunga Devabhuti.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Who overthrew the last Kanva (Susharman)?
items.back: The Satavahanas (c. 28 BCE).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Which dynasty ruled Kalinga under Kharavela?

items.front: Inscription and religion linked to Kharavela?

items.front: Kharavela's queen's cave at Udayagiri?

items.front: Who built Sanchi Stupa and who added the toranas?

items.front: Three sculpture schools of the period?

items.back: From the 2nd century BCE to the 3rd century AD, between the Mauryas and the Guptas.
